mentions.name: SQLFlow
mentions.description: A lightweight stream processing tool that uses DuckDB to run SQL-based processing on streaming data. It aims to fill the gap between heavyweight JVM-based stream processing systems and bespoke custom solutions by being performant, fully featured, observable, and SQL-capable.
mentions.problem: The industry lacks lightweight, fully featured stream processing solutions; existing options are either heavyweight JVM-based systems or bespoke custom solutions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Duckdb for streaming data!

https://github.com/turbolytics/sql-flow

I think the industry lacks lightweight fully featured stream processing solutions. I think it’s either heavyweight jvm or bespoke custom solutions

Sqlflow aims to be a middle ground , performant, fully featured, observable and supports sql
